name: Cable Wrist Curl
steps: Sit facing a low cable with your forearms on your thighs and your hands just beyond your knees holding its bar palms up.
Bend your wrists to draw your palms toward your forearms.
Lower the bar by extending your wrists slowly.
tips: Keep your forearms resting on your thighs.
Move smoothly through your full wrist range without bouncing at the bottom.
